preconditions.description: The length of the input string S must be between 10 and 40 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c in '-+() ' for c in S) for emails
preconditions.description: For email addresses, the string S must contain only alphanumeric characters, '+', '-', '(', ')', or spaces.
For phone numbers, the length of S must be between 10 and 13 digits.

postconditions.description: The returned value for an email must be in lowercase.
The returned value for a phone number must be masked according to the specified format.
